news.title: EUPHEX TAKES ON A LONG CAMPAIGN IN OOREDOO NATION CONTENDER SERIES
news.excerpt: Nine rounds, three wins, and a grueling stretch of Maldivian competition.
body: Euphex entered the Ooredoo Nation Esports Contender Series 3 2026 for a demanding stretch of Mobile Legends competition, facing a series of opponents across the tournament.
The campaign opened with a 1–0 victory over EchO AlphA, giving Euphex a winning start. The team then faced BNS XEROW in Round 2, where the series ended 0–1.
Euphex returned to winning form in Round 4 with a 1–0 victory over Hi!_Ping, before facing KUIS Vanguards in Round 5.

The latter part of the campaign brought a series of difficult matchups. Euphex faced LF Esports (0–1), LNN SLFO RELI FAMILIA (0–1), and EchO ForcE (0–1), while also securing a 1–0 win over MVK FC in Round 8.
With another extended tournament campaign completed, Euphex moved into the next stage of its 2026 schedule, with the ON Esports Flash Series coming just over a month later.

news.title: EUPHEX RETURNS TO ACTION IN ON ESPORTS FLASH SERIES
news.excerpt: A short, sharp Round 1 exit against familiar foes LF Esports.
body: Just over a month after its Ooredoo Nation Contender Series campaign, Euphex returned to competitive action in the ON Esports Flash Series – MLBB 2026.
The tournament gave the squad another opportunity to compete in a focused series, this time against LF Esports in Round 1.
The matchup ended 0–2 in favour of LF Esports, bringing Euphex's Flash Series campaign to a close after the opening round.
The result also made LF Esports a familiar opponent for Euphex in the 2026 campaign, having previously met the team during Round 6 of the Ooredoo Nation Esports Contender Series.
With the Flash Series completed, Euphex's competitive schedule continued into August, into one of the year's major Maldivian esports competitions.

news.title: EUPHEX OPENS DMGC 2026 WITH BACK-TO-BACK WINS
news.excerpt: 2–0 over BOTS United, 2–0 over KOF Suzuran — then the LNN wall.
body: Euphex returned to competition in August for the Mobile Legends DMGC 2026, opening its campaign with two consecutive victories.
The team started the tournament against BOTS United, securing a 2–0 victory in Round 1.
Euphex carried that result into Round 2, where they faced KOF Suzuran. Another 2–0 victory gave Euphex a second consecutive series win.
Round 3 brought a different challenge against LNN SLFO RELI FAMILIA, with Euphex ultimately falling 0–2.
The DMGC 2026 MLBB qualifier featured a MVR 10,000 prize pool, with teams competing for a place in the wider DMGC competition.
